resolutions.subject: Aluminum, polymer-can, and supercapacitor stripe meaning
resolutions.action: Bind the sleeve stripe label to the negative electrical terminal independently of tantalum markings.

resolutions.subject: Tantalum bar meaning
resolutions.action: Bind the molded tantalum bar label to the positive electrical terminal independently of can stripes.

resolutions.subject: Bridge rectifier PLUS, MINUS, AC1, and AC2 terminal positions
resolutions.action: Keep automatic electrical binding blocked until a manufacturer drawing establishes PLUS and MINUS; AC1 and AC2 may interchange only afterward.

resolutions.subject: PLCC-28 reference candidate
resolutions.action: Keep P89LPC935 as the PLCC-28 reference and exclude AT27C256R from this entry because it is PLCC-32.

resolutions.subject: BGA and WLCSP datasheet bottom-view coordinates
resolutions.action: Transform a datasheet bottom view into the OHMNI top-view convention exactly once by mirroring X; retain ball names.

resolutions.subject: XT package terminals versus footprint pads
resolutions.action: Map OHMNI terminal 1 at -X to footprint pad 2 and terminal 2 at +X to footprint pad 1; leave polarity unbound.

resolutions.subject: Reference-part package dimensions versus 3D package dimensions
resolutions.action: Record exact, compatible_variant, or mismatch per reference binding; mismatch blocks automatic footprint and 3D selection without changing either source.
